game.name: Cyberpunk 2077
game.desc: A sprawling open-world action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour, and body modification. Play as V, a mercenary outlaw chasing a one-of-a-kind implant that is the key to immortality, making choices that shape your story and the world around you.

game.name: Elden Ring
game.desc: A critically acclaimed dark fantasy Action RPG set in the Lands Between, a sprawling new world rich with bloody history and deep lore. Players explore a seamless open world, battling formidable foes and engaging in deeply customizable, challenging combat that emphasizes exploration, discovery, and a high degree of skill-based mastery.
game.review: Just a fine game, 4 out of 5 stars

game.name: Black Myth: Wukong
game.desc: A highly anticipated Action RPG inspired by the classic Chinese novel, Journey to the West. Players take on the role of the Destined One, the legendary Sun Wukong, who must embark on a treacherous journey to uncover the truth behind a glorious old legend.
